title: Mean First Passage Times and Fundamental Tensors of Higher Order Markov Chains
summary: The mean first passage times are among the most critical characteristics of a Markov chain. In this paper, we focus on the scenario in which one or more states of a higher order ergodic Markov chain are modified to be absorbing. We prove that the resulting chain has to be absorbing. For a higher order absorbing Markov chain, we prove that the equation its fundamental tensor satisfies must be nonsingular and provide a MATLAB function {\tt fund} for solving the equation.
